topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Overview
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer welcomes the class and frames the lecture on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Innate Immune Recognition via PAMPs, DAMPs, and Pattern Recognition Receptors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system senses infection and tissue damage through molecular patterns and pattern recognition receptor pathways.

topics.label: Inflammatory Activation, Cell Trafficking, and Systemic Responses
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how activated sentinel cells direct leukocyte recruitment into tissues and mediate downstream systemic inflammatory responses.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the mechanisms that shut down inflammation, repair damaged tissue, and produce chronic adaptations like granulomas.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the presentation and announces the subject of the upcoming lecture.
